components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action. Violet gradient glass with glow shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 3rem; padding: 0 1.25rem; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 1.5rem; background: linear-gradient(135deg, hsl(262 83% 60%), hsl(270 70% 60%)); color: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(162,95,255,0.35); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); cursor: pointer; transition: all 300ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(162,95,255,0.4); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.98); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Ghost glass button for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 3rem; padding: 0 1.25rem; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 1.5rem; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15); color: hsl(220 10% 12%); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); box-shadow: 0 4px 24px -4px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); cursor: pointer; transition: all 300ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: hsla(262 83% 60% / 0.2); transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: Default frosted glass container with 2rem radius.

components.css: .ds-card { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.12), rgba(255,255,255,0.05)); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); border-radius: 2rem; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); box-shadow: 0 8px 32px -8px rgba(0,0,0,0.12); overflow: hidden; } .ds-card-header { padding: 1.5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid hsla(220 10% 55% / 0.1); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; color: hsl(220 10% 12%); } .ds-card-body { padding: 1.5rem; }

components.name: Glass Input
components.description: Frosted glass text input with primary focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input-wrapper { position: relative; } .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 3rem; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 1rem; padding: 0 1.25rem; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; color: hsl(220 10% 12%); outline: none; transition: all 150ms ease; backdrop-filter: blur(10px); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: hsl(220 10% 55%); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: hsla(262 83% 60% / 0.2); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: hsl(262 83% 60%); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px hsla(262 83% 60% / 0.15); }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Sidebar navigation item with active state glow.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; color: hsl(220 8% 35%); transition: all 150ms ease; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color: hsl(220 10% 12%); } .ds-nav-item-active { background: hsl(262 83% 60%); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 20px hsla(262 83% 60% / 0.2); }

components.name: XP Bar
components.description: Gamification XP progress bar with neumorphic background and gradient glow fill.
components.css: .ds-xp-bar { height: 0.75rem; background: hsl(220 30% 96%); border-radius: 9999px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: inset 3px 3px 6px rgba(163,177,198,0.3), inset -3px -3px 6px rgba(255,255,255,0.4); } .ds-xp-bar-fill { height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, hsl(262 83% 60%), hsl(185 85% 60%)); border-radius: 9999px; transition: width 500ms ease; box-shadow: 0 0 8px hsla(262 83% 60% / 0.4); }

narrative.overview:
A glass dashboard that feels like commanding a console — transparent layers, glowing accents, and tactile feedback. Every surface is a pane of frosted glass floating over a deep gradient-lit background. The interface is youthful but respected: gamification elements pop with neumorphic depth and animated glow, while data surfaces stay clean, scannable, and professional.

This system explicitly rejects mediocrity — no generic SaaS templates, no flat bootstrap cards, no inconsistent spacing, no clashing visual languages. Glassmorphism is not a trend here; it is the material. The frosted layer is the canvas, the glow is the emphasis, and the neumorphic badges are the reward.
keyCharacteristics: Frosted glass surfaces with 20px backdrop blur
Deep radial gradient backgrounds (purple + cyan) that shift between light/dark
Neumorphic gamification elements (XP bars, HP bars, rank badges) for tactile reward feel
Animated feedback for every state change (grade flash, streak glow, level spring)
High contrast text on glass surfaces — readable in any lighting

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Púrpura Colegial is the only accent that carries system-wide semantic weight. Cyan, lime, orange, pink, and violet are confined to gamification contexts.

rules.name: The Glass Overlay Rule
rules.body: All colored surfaces are either glass (translucent with blur) or gradient backgrounds. No flat solid-color backgrounds.

rules.name: The Nunito Boundary Rule
rules.body: Nunito is forbidden outside of gamification stats (XP, HP, level, rank, coins, badges).

rules.name: The Float-Don't-Float Rule
rules.body: Every glass surface must have a shadow. No shadow = no glass.

rules.name: The No-Flat Rule
rules.body: Every component must have at least one layer of depth: glass blur, gradient, shadow, or neumorphic inset.

dos: Use glassmorphism as the default material for cards, buttons, and navigation.
Use neumorphic inset shadows for XP bars, HP bars, and progress indicators.
Animate every state change with purposeful transitions.
Keep high contrast on all text-over-glass combinations.
Use Nunito exclusively for gamification stats.
Stagger entrance animations for lists of cards or students.
donts: Use flat, solid-color backgrounds for cards or containers.
Use generic SaaS templates or mediocre designs.
Use border-left or border-right as a colored accent stripe.
Use identical card grids with icon + heading + text.
Exceed 3 accent colors on any single screen.
